title_sq: Apartament per shitje tek West Home Residence ne Farke
description_sq:
Ne Farke, tek West Home Residence, shesim apartament 3+1 me 2 poste parkimi.
Apartamenti organziohet ne sallon ndenje me kuzhine dhe dalje ne nje verande fantastike me pamje nga liqeni, 3 dhoma gjumi ku dhoma matrimoniale eshte me garderobe, tualet dhe dalje ne verande, dhome femijesh, dhome miqsh dhe nje tualet dite. Rezidenca eshte ne fazen e pare te ndertimit, perfundon ne 2029 dhe pranohet pagese me keste. 
Per me teper informacion, me kontaktoni!
title_en: Apartment for sale at West Home Residence in Farke
description_en: In Farke, at West Home Residence, we sell a 3+1 apartment with 2 parking spaces. The apartment is organized in a living room with a kitchen and access to a fantastic veranda with a view of the lake, 3 bedrooms where the matrimonial room has a wardrobe, a bathroom and exit to the veranda, a children's room, a guest room and a day toilet. The residence is in the first phase of construction, it will be completed in 2029 and payment in installments is accepted. For more information, contact me!
